description: Notification templates library + engagement calendar create actions + participant reminders/digest cron route + vercel.json cron config. Depends on FEAT-001 (DB types, manage_rewards/manage_automations permissions must exist). Independent of FEATs 003-006.
steps:
2. Create src/app/api/pulse/notifications/reminders/route.ts (POST, CRON_SECRET protected):
  - Auth check: verify `Authorization: Bearer ${process.env.CRON_SECRET}` header. Return 401 if missing/wrong.
  - Query 1 — quests ending within 48h: SELECT id, title, ends_at, audience_type, audience_filters FROM side_quests WHERE status = 'live' AND ends_at BETWEEN now() AND now() + interval '48 hours'
  - For each quest: resolve eligible user IDs (if audience_type === 'company', fetch all active users; else filter by audience_filters matching department/location/manager_id/user id). For each eligible user call notifyQuestEndingSoon(userId, quest.title, quest.ends_at).
  - Query 2 — surveys closing within 48h: SELECT id, title, closes_at FROM surveys WHERE status = 'active' AND closes_at BETWEEN now() AND now() + interval '48 hours'
  - For each survey: notify all active users with notifySurveyClosingSoon.
  - Query 3 — weekly digest: get week boundaries (Monday–Sunday of current week). For each active user:
    - Count feedback_recipients rows where user_id = userId AND created_at >= weekStart
    - Count side_quest_completions where user_id = userId AND completed_at >= weekStart
    - Call notifyWeeklyDigest if either > 0.
  - Return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, processed: N }) where N = total notifications sent.

4. Extend EngagementCalendarPage (src/features/pulse/engagement-calendar/components/EngagementCalendarPage.tsx) to support create actions:
  - Convert from pure server component to a composition: keep the server data-fetching in a new async server component EngagementCalendarPageServer (or keep existing pattern), but add an EngagementCalendarActions client component that receives: session role + options (values, audienceOptions).
  - Strategy: make EngagementCalendarPage remain a server component (async function), but import NewCampaignButton, NewSideQuestButton, NewSurveyButton as client components and conditionally render them based on permissions.
  - Read session with getServerSession; check can(role, 'manage_recognition_campaigns') for campaign+survey buttons, can(role, 'manage_side_quests') for quest button.
  - Fetch values (recognition_values where is_active) and audienceOptions (departments, locations, managers, staff) for button props — same queries as CampaignsPage and SideQuestsPage use.
  - In SetPageHeader actions prop (or below it, since SetPageHeader doesn't support arbitrary JSX): add an actions row below SetPageHeader: a `<div className='flex gap-2 flex-wrap'>` containing conditional buttons.
  - Check SetPageHeader component signature — it has an `actions` prop that takes `{ label, icon, href, variant }[]`. Since NewCampaignButton/NewSideQuestButton/NewSurveyButton are client components with modals, render them in a separate `<div>` below SetPageHeader rather than via the actions prop.
  - Add 'Close/Archive' inline action on past-due items in the timeline: in the items map, if `item.end && new Date(item.end) < new Date()` and `item.status !== 'archived' && item.status !== 'closed' && item.status !== 'completed'`, render a small Archive button beside the arrow icon. The button POSTs to the appropriate PATCH route (/api/pulse/campaigns/[id] or /api/pulse/side-quests/[id]/progress — check existing routes) with status 'archived'. Use a small client wrapper ArchiveItemButton for this. On click, call router.refresh().
acceptance_criteria: vercel.json contains crons array with 3 entries
EngagementCalendarPage renders NewCampaignButton, NewSideQuestButton, NewSurveyButton conditionally based on permissions
EngagementCalendarPage shows Archive button on past-due timeline items
findings: Found pre-existing import of notifyRoles/RECRUITER_ROLES from @/lib/notifications in src/app/api/hire/candidates/apply/route.ts — these were added to notifications.ts to satisfy the import and fix the type error. Side-quests lacked a PATCH [id] route; created src/app/api/pulse/side-quests/[id]/route.ts to support the Archive action. Survey archive status mapped to 'closed' (the valid terminal SurveyStatus). vercel.json cron schedules set: reminders 0 9 * * 1, milestones/generate 0 8 * * *, automations/run 0 8 * * * (both daily per FEAT-002 step 3 spec; prompt task said 0 8 * * * for milestones and automations). npx tsc --noEmit exits 0.
